name: s81sl_cap_rt
structural_change: S81U-CAP2: the flat s81sl_cap failed the clock rule (22,261 sinks / one root, TT insertion 368.5 ps > 300, physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap/gate_result.json); split into 2 x tree leaf (s81sl_cap_tr, one master, E instance MY) + root leaf (s81sl_cap_rt) with own clock roots and registered seams (nc RST flop -> n6 P1 flop, no added edge), parent s81sl_capc = instances + wiring. S81U-CAP3: pairing-store lookups read one register early with forwarding (gate's 18-level fb_t -> cnt stage, ~795 ps), reset relay 20 copies, SRAM on the lattice; 0 edges moved (cap_bench identical).

job.purpose: S81U-CAP2: capture-root ROOT leaf (n6 + direct-mapped finish store SRAM + leaf decode), 1 instance in s81sl_capc; benched through the composed ot_s81sl_cap.

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (S81-SLICE): every data input lands in a flop at the pin (the *_c capture flops) and every output is a flop; recipe-3 pin_regs would add a second unpriced stage on every slice seam.

why_floorplan: 259.2 x 108 (S81U-CAP3): SRAM at (43.2, 43.2) on the 43.2 lattice (CAP2 had it off-lattice at 23.04 / 23.76); its rd_out pins sit on its W edge and wd_in on its E edge, so the outline is 6 lattice steps wide to leave a ~42-um std-cell column on each side; one contiguous ring band (S 41 um: DEC + cw outputs to the S face; N 33 um: n6 / FIN under the N pins; W/E 41-42 um: pairing store, beside the macro's ports). clk/rst_n mid N face between the trees (cluster spine channel); N face = W-tree word (under u_tw), cfg + cw_n (middle), E-tree word (under u_te MY); S face cw_s + fault; ~10k flops, one root.
